reviews.text:
I cannot say enough wonderful things about this clinic. Firstly, from the moment I walked, the staff at the front desk was warm and welcoming.

As for the appointment itself, the vet, Dr. Ciarlillo was absolutely wonderful with my cat. He took great attention, care and time with her, treating her gently and thoroughly.

After the exam was completed, he explained everything meticulously and thoughtfully, answering all of my questions, and reassuring me with my concerns. I especially appreciated that he explained the more complex issues with me in a way that was easy for me to understand.

Thank you to the entire team for your professionalism, warmth, and dedication. I am incredibly appreciative of the care we received and would highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for outstanding veterinary care.
The team is fantastic. They take great care of my babies. I went through a difficult situation and they were very understanding and accommodating. I'm so glad I found this veterinary clinic.

🐾❤️ A veterinary clinic I 100% recommend! I am delighted with the care and welcome we received. The entire team is wonderful, kind, and attentive. They treat both the animals and their owners with immense patience and love. You can tell they practice their profession with passion and a big heart. Furthermore, their prices are affordable, which is truly wonderful. 🐱💕 The clinic also offers veterinary services in Spanish, which makes you feel more comfortable, understood, and confident.

I want to express my sincerest thanks to Dr. Ana, who was a true angel to my little cat Amira and to me throughout this entire process. ❤️🙏 Thank you, Doctor, for your kindness, patience, dedication, and for taking such loving care of my little Amirita. Your humanity and support meant the world to us.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for making such a wonderful difference! We're leaving 🇨🇦🇨🇷 with a magnificent experience and eternal gratitude. May God always bless you and the entire wonderful Veterinary Care team. 🙏🌷🌼🍀❤️🐾

Incredible experience.

Had to leave my cat there in their care for almost a week and from the moment we arrived to our appointment to the day we picked him up, every individual there that I interacted with greeted me with kindness and compassion.

The vets and technicians were clear and concise in their explanations and daily updates and the price was more than fair. We were allowed to visit every day, and were never nade to feel like we were a bother, they were incredibly welcoming.

Could not have asked for a better experience!

Update Sept-2-2026⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Brought my girl in for an ear infection and had the pleasure of meeting  Dr.Mimouni he and the staff did a fantastic job of diagnosing the infection and explaining how to apply the medication , we are very grateful for their expertise and professionalism.

Update Aug—17-2026⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
My girl had an eye infection  Dr.Lipari and staff did an amazing job  diagnosing and treating it , it cleared up  within a week ,

Aug-1-2025⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Dr.lipari  and the whole staff are excellent  honest trustworthy professionals. The service, care, and  pricing they provide is second to none.
Parking is difficult.
The best veterinary teams!

If I could give this wonderful place and its team 10/5, I would! They are attentive, kind, supportive, and never make you feel rushed. My dog runs to the door as soon as she realizes where we are headed! From the front desk, to the technicians, to the veterinarians...every single one of them is downright amazing. I am immensely grateful to be a client here. Ps: the clinic itself is gorgeous and always spotless.
$120 for a consultation for my cat, vet was fast and friendly. He said it would be around $350 for bloodwork but that it wasn't necessary at this point and didn't try to upsell me.

Absolutely refreshing to have professionals that actually care about your pet and not try to upsell any service or exam. I would highly recommend this veterinary for anyone who wants the best for their pet.
Last minute call and got a spot 👌 fast and efficient …

I can confidently assert that this establishment is the best I've encountered for pet care. When I took my cat Kiwi in for an injury, the staff went above and beyond to find a suitable appointment time and delivered exceptional service in a clean and friendly atmosphere.

I had my dog ​​operated on at this clinic and I couldn't be happier with my experience. The entire team is caring, professional, and really takes the time to answer all our questions, which is very reassuring.

A big plus: the service is offered in French, Spanish, and English.
Dre. Allan and her team are amazing!
Always the most care and thought put into each and every visit. Been a client for 20 years!

They are very attentive to our puppies.

What we particularly appreciated about them is that they don't try to sell us all sorts of medications, tests, and other things at any cost.
They give us excellent advice, and we feel free to pay whatever fees are necessary or not.
The customer service (for both humans and animals) is exceptional.

I want to express my sincere gratitude to this absolutely exceptional veterinary clinic.

We went through an extremely difficult time with the loss of our cat, who had been with us for over 18 years. During this ordeal, your team made all the difference. You were remarkably responsive, incredibly kind, and above all, showed genuine empathy that deeply touched us.

While we were clients of another clinic in the neighborhood, we chose to go to an independent clinic, and we couldn't be more grateful for the welcome we received here. You respected our grief, welcomed us without judgment, and supported us with great compassion during this incredibly painful time.

Thank you for taking the time. Thank you for your kindness. Thank you for understanding what our cat meant to us.

Your compassion will remain etched in our memories.

Real compassion and dedication to animal care. They immediately sprang into action when my daughter brought in a badly injured animal she found on the sidewalk home from school (after another vet turned her away because she didn’t have an appointment.). They have a sign by the front desk saying they take care of all types of dogs, without discrimination about breed or type.  Their care extended to the injured animal we found and they were very kind and took time explaining things to my daughter. The people of this vet clinic are an amazing part of our community in NDG.  Pretty sure I finally found the right vet for our dogs, too.  Thank you for making the world a better place!

I've been bringing my beautiful dog to this clinic since July 2025 and I had received an amazing service and support since the beginning from Dre Catalina Zapata and Dr  Pierre-Olivier Laberge. My little angel was diagnosed with an immunitary condition so, we have to monitor him very close. The service, te attitude and the patience of all the stuff is wonderful. Thank you
Great service, the staff is very professional.
So kind and lovely.

We had an excellent experience with Dr. Lipari, Gabriella, and Laura, who were so kind and compassionate to us and our animals. They made sure we had every option laid out with transparent pricing, and there was no guilting or tricking into extra services or products. Truly just incredibly kind and loving staff who clearly care so deeply about animals and people. Thank you for all that you do!

Went to the clinic with my cat for emergency care after she started having blood in her urine. They were very professional and kind, thorough in their examination and offered options of care including pain management. My cat recovered quickly from her bladder cristals.

Although the staff was very lovely and kind, I found the quality of regular vet care to be disappointing compared to other clinics I have been to. My cat's exam was done in about 10 minutes, and the vet did not ask any questions about her diet or lifestyle, didn't check her eyes and ears, and didn't feel her body carefully for abnormalities, only checked her heart and her temperature. Perhaps my last clinic was just exceptionally detailed, but I expected more attention to detail from this clinic especially considering the price.
I hate to leave a bad review and want to highlight that my pet's needs were met, although with less quality than I was expecting based on other reviews. I will be exploring other options for my regular vet care, despite the lovely staff and environment.

I cannot recommend this clinic enough. Everyone who works here clearly loves their job. The vets are knowledgeable, patient, and have always given me all the time I need to ask my questions to make sure my pup is taken care of. The staff are all kind and welcoming and go above and beyond at every visit. I can't think of taking my pup anywhere else.

From the moment you walk in, the experience at Animal Care in NDG is truly refreshing. The team is warm, attentive, and genuinely cares about the animals. The level of compassion combined with an efficient and well organized administrative staff makes such a difference. Thank you for the excellent care and great service!

We started coming to this clinic when we moved to NDG and overall I’m very happy with it. I’ve seen a few of the vets here, but the last couple of appointments have been with Dr. Mimouni and I’m very happy with him! He is gentle with my pup and listens attentively to my concerns. Getting appointments is pretty easy and I have even used the Dorval location in an emergency and was pleased with that location as well.

It's hard to find a good vet. I have been to many and was left disappointed.

Luckily I found this one and have been very happy since.

Excellent experience. They were very transparent about prices BEFORE booking the appointment or treatment. The staff is really friendly, completely bilingual, and the on-site test results are quick. 100%
Caring. Fair.

My elderly cat was recently diagnosed with diabetes, I just wanted to give a big thank you to Dr Escalon and all the staff at the clinic, they took the time to explain to me my pets treatment and reassure me when I had questions or wasn’t sure if I was doing things right.  5/5 recommend this vet!❤️
Excellent service!

What I appreciate most about this place is their quick response and helpfulness. I was able to get an appointment quickly when my puppy needed one, while many other veterinary clinics weren't accepting new patients. The vets are incredibly kind and professional, as is the reception staff. Thank you!
We are in love the services, our cats they are never nervous with Dr Zapata, she is so patience and lovely with our boys. And has the precise diagnosis.
This is such a good vet clinic! The staff are super kind and always treated my cat with care. I’d be staying with them if I didn’t have to move 💛 definitely recommend checking them out. …

I’ve been to both the NDG and Dorval locations, and I can honestly say this clinic is amazing no matter where you go. Both teams have been nothing but kind, professional, and genuinely caring. The NDG team is sooo patient with my reactive dog. Vet visits were something I used to be really stressed about be but I feel at ease here! No matter which Dr. I’ve seen, they’ve always taken the time to explain everything clearly and treated my animals with so much compassion. It’s rare to find a vet clinic where you don’t feel like they’re trying to take advantage of you when you’re so vulnerable & in a state of panic/stress. Shoutout to Dr. Garcia Martinez and Dr. Lipari I’m so so grateful for the care they’ve provided for my animals I wouldn’t trust anyone else 🥰💖

Incredible vet! They helped my cat when he had a urinary blockage. All the staff were super nice and I could tell they really cared about helping my cat. This is definitely the best vet clinic i’ve ever been to!

Absolutely amazing clinic. I struggle with giving injections to my cat and he requires a daily injection for a long treatment, all the staff at this clinic has been so so helpful and I am so great full to them for taking care of him and lifting this weight off my shoulders. Not to mention the very reasonable pricing.

Absolutely positively the best veterinarian clinic to bring your animal when they are in need of love and care. The team was extremely helpful,,,  extremely attentive,,, and saved my cat's life without a doubt. I appreciate you guys more than you know and I will refer your office to anybody and everybody I know. Both my wife and I thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

F.Y.I Solito is doing fantastic and recovering more and more everyday.
Great vet, great service as always. We love Dr. Gilmour and the whole team.

I had a very disappointing experience at this clinic. The vet clearly had no idea how to properly handle dogs or make them feel safe and comfortable. Instead of showing patience or understanding, they seemed careless and dismissive.

On top of that, I was given ridiculous food recommendations that didn’t make sense for my dog’s needs. What upset me most was that the vet falsely claimed my dog was aggressive and had tried to bite, which is completely untrue and damaging. My dog is not aggressive, and this felt like an excuse to cover up their poor handling.

I would not recommend this vet to anyone who truly cares about their pet’s well-being.

After my first visit with my puppy: Great experience! The reception staff and the technician were particularly attentive and professional; they did everything to put me at ease and also to make my puppy comfortable, as he's not yet used to veterinary exams and outings to places with lots of people and dogs. The vet was good too; he seemed new to the procedures, but it went well. I would have preferred if the scale for weighing the dog wasn't in the waiting/entrance area, as it's more complicated for anxious dogs. But in the end, the technician was really good, and it went well too. I'm glad I chose this place for my puppy!
I can’t say enough about this veterinary clinic. Every single employee is amazing! A special shout out to Dr. Lipari for saving my dog and finally figuring out what’s wrong with her <3

Dr Lipari is the most empathetic gracious vet as is the entire staff at NDG office.
My puppy got the best attention during some trying times.
They are a god sent gift!
Excellent service, very professional.

Nelson came for his daily visit. Unfortunately Nelson ate part of a cob of corn thus creating an emergency.
It was closing time for the clinic, yet they stayed open until we arrived. Both my husband and I were very distraught. The vet along with all the employees showed us compassion, kindness and empathy. We were reassured that all would be done to help Nelson.
Sure enough after inducing vomiting the cob came out. Nelson had a long sleep after the ordeal.
We can’t thank the clinic enough for taking such good care of Nelson and comforting us at the same time.

Highly recommended! My experience at Gilmour Vet. (Animal care NDG) has been truly outstanding. Everyone I’ve interacted with has been kind, helpful, and genuinely caring. Dr. Escalon is a wonderful professional—empathetic, knowledgeable, and incredibly kind. He took the time to offer thoughtful advice on how to improve the health and quality of life of Avana (my senior cat). I’m very grateful for the care and attention we've received. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for compassionate, professional, and top-quality veterinary care.

Wow! We had an incredible experience today at Gilmour Vet. We took our cat to do his nail trim and it was a seamless experience!! Normally he freaks out and it is very difficult for other techs at other clinics to get it done but the staff today was incredible!!! Our cat hardly squirmed and he seemed so much more at ease. Thank you so much to this amazing clinic for your patience and care. We will def be coming back!!

I was very excited to bring our new puppy here after reading all of the amazing reviews. I scheduled a first check up and vaccinations at the NDG location. The experience was disappointing. The vet showed almost no interest in our puppy. After being weighed by the receptionist, the vet brought us into the examination room where she gave him a few treats and then gave him his shot. She asked zero questions and did no check up. I asked her if she could show me what the best way to clean the puppy's ears are so she showed me. And that was it. I was baffled by the experience, as I had expected a check up and some kind of feedback on our puppy's health. Needless to say, I am looking for a new vet.

I used to have a good experience with Gilmore Vet Service back when Dr. Gilmore was there. He was fair, professional, and we were always satisfied with the care our dog received.

Unfortunately, since he left, the quality of service has gone downhill. I brought my dog in for a wound on his back leg. After three visits, the issue was still not resolved. Each time, I was prescribed more medications, antibiotics, creams, and shampoos, without seeing real improvement. It felt like the goal was to keep charging me instead of finding a real solution.

I later called to schedule a follow-up appointment for that same dog and also for my new puppy. I clearly explained I would be bringing two dogs, and the receptionist told me the total would be no more than $100. But when I arrived, the vet asked for an additional $50, with no flexibility, even though the receptionist gave me the wrong information.

On top of that, the tick medications at this clinic are much more expensive than what you can find online. I ended up paying around $550 for medications for both dogs — which is far too much.

When I asked the vet for some form of compensation or acknowledgment of the miscommunication, he stayed firm on the price and didn’t offer anything.

This was very disappointing, especially since my dog  has been coming here since he was a puppy. Unfortunately, this was my last visit. The service and care just aren’t the same since Dr. Gilmore left.

We had the privilege of having Dr Lipari during the final few months of my dog being alive. Through many health issues, she was there for us, and helped us along the journey of saying goodbye. I will never forget the kindness she gave us and hope to work with her in the future when I have another furry friend!

The vet is such a strange place to look forward to as most visit during stressful times when our animals require care, however it is the complete opposite with Gilmour - I literally look forward to each and every visit because I encounter the most wonderful humans each and every time. The level of care and compassion offered is unparalleled and I am so thankful to have such a capable and loving team to lean on for absolutely anything with my 15 1/2 year old pupper. Chloe, Jess (miss you), Gab and Dr. Lipari are angels on this Earth.
the staff is amazing here
Great care for my dog and cats! Love this place.
Amazing service!!
The only veterinary clinic I have put my full trust into. The vets and staff go above and beyond to take the best care of my multiple cats and my small dog. Grateful they are assessable.

Dr.Lipari and the staff is simply amazing and Calm :)

Appricotti feels safe 🐈🐅 & our little Peachy too 🦁🐱 …
Best vet ever! Every single visit there has been amazing, very kind staff and not too expensive in comparison to other places :)

The best Vet in Montreal. Kindest staff 🥰
Dr. Gilmore is known in the city for his dedication and honest service. I’ve been going here for over 20 years. I can’t thank the Gilmore Team enough for all their work and support with my fur babies. …

My cat and I had been in car accident on the way to moving to Montreal. The vet services we received we stupendous. They were thorough checking over my cat, running blood work, and explained everything very well. Even though my cat was still in pain, he liked the vet and the techs. They cared for him but were also very empathetic and concerned about my health too. Even though I had not been to this client here before, they fit us in immediately for an appointment and check up. Will absolutely be returning to this vet clinic in the future!
Veterinarian was early and staff were excellent. Vet did not push unnecessary treatments. We couldn’t have asked for a better first vet experience 🥰 …

I can’t recommend Gilmour Veterinary Services N.D.G. enough! What truly makes this clinic stand out is their genuine care for animals— from the warm reception team to the attentive and skilled vets. They focus on what’s best for your pet, not just the most expensive solution, which is so refreshing. I’m incredibly grateful to have my cat, Chooch, cared for by such a compassionate and competent team!

Good price! I went there for my cats, and the service was pretty good. One of my cats had dental work done at their sister clinic, and I was able to get the follow-up care again in NDG. Excellent follow-up with this vet :)

Dear Veterinarian Gilmour
I wanted to express heartfelt gratitude for you exceptional care and dedication. Your compassionate approach and expertise proved that euthanasia wasn't the only option. Your commitment to finding alternative solutions is truly commendable.
Your transparent and affordable pricing made the treatment process much less stressful.  Your involvement kept me informed and reassured.
Your veterinary Clinic exemplifies excellence in animal care. I highly recommend your services to anyone seeking Top notch compassionate care for your pets . TRUTH ...
The best!
Superb vet. I can highly recommend bringing your dog here. The staff are all kind and respectful. I’ve had dogs for over 50 years, and their knowledge is excellent. Lovely waiting room too!
Always friendly and helpful!  Knowledgable and practical.
Very personal experience, dog got more attention tha than me. Not like Vet et Nous and other places like that, that just try to sell you services and tests

After having gone through a not-so-great experience in the past, Gilmour Veterinary Services is a breath of fresh of air. Everytime I bring my mini doxies in, I know they’re in great hands. Responsive, reassuring and excellent customer service. Couldn’t ask for a better vet!!

My pets are in great hands here. :) they are always straight forward, informative, caring, and never rush me out the door. You are given real time and attention for each of your pets. I am so glad I found this place!
